openingMessage: The meeting isn't the safety program. The meeting is where we sharpen it. The field is where we prove it.
openingWhy: July 13, TXL 27 Unit 4 — Ralph Forbes ran his LMRA on valves the paperwork said were bled off. They weren't. Trapped pressure, found before the break instead of during it. That's this meeting doing its job out there.
leadershipThought: Know your anchor point is rated for your fall distance before you step off the platform. A dropped tool at 20 feet hits hard. Tether it before you climb, not after.
